items.sentence: This pond ecosystem holds frogs, water plants, and many insects.

A mature oak tree produces many acorns every autumn season.
Protecting this wetland habitat keeps rare frogs from disappearing.
Rangers maintain the forest paths so plants stay undamaged.
The tide rises twice each day along this rocky shore.
The seesaw found its balance when both children sat still.
A grand waterfall drops down the cliff into the river.
The city will grant our club money for tree planting.
